channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Martin Roth-Initiative: Temporary Relocation for Artists and Cultural Actors at Risk (Programme Line 1, 2026 call)
    https://www.martin-roth-initiative.de/en/application-programme-line-1
    Martin Roth-Initiative (Goethe-Institut and ifa, funded by the German Federal Foreign Office) · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · Monthly scholarship for the relocated artist, plus insurance, language courses, psychosocial support, counselling and training, visa support, and personnel funding for the host organisation. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 10 Aug 2026 (10 Aug to 16 Aug 2026).

  • transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • transmediale x ARKO Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/transmediale-x-arko-residency
    transmediale (in cooperation with Arts Council Korea / ARKO) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Two-month residency with an artist fee of EUR 1,500 per month, additional production support, plus travel and accommodation support for the festival and residency. For duos or collectives the fee remains the same and is shared. No application fee.
  • Vilem Flusser Residency for Artistic Research 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/vilem-flusser-residency-for-artistic-research-2027
    transmediale and the Vilem Flusser Archive, Universitat der Kunste Berlin (UdK) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Two-month residency with an artist fee of EUR 1,500 per residency month. NO funds are available for travel or housing. For duos or collectives the fee remains the same and is shared. No application fee.
  • Institut francais x Cite internationale des arts Residencies 2027-2028
    https://www.institutfrancais.com/en/programme/residence-and-professional-mobility/residencies-institut-francais-x-cite-internationale
    Institut francais de Paris (with Cite internationale des arts) · deadline 08 Oct 2026 · Furnished, Wi-Fi-equipped studio apartment in Paris with monthly costs covered by the Institut francais. The nominating partner organisation must provide a residency stipend of at least EUR 1,100 per month and cover the artist's international travel, insurance (health, repatriation, liability) and any visa fees. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 27 Jul 2026 (27 Jul to 02 Aug 2026).

  • Red Quincho: Beca Constelaciones 2026 (4th Edition)
    https://redquincho.ar/beca-constelaciones-2026/
    Red Quincho · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · ARS 1,000,000 (around USD 690) per grant toward mobility, living costs and production, plus one month of lodging. 15 grants available. No application fee.
  • Association Francoise pour l'oeuvre contemporaine x Cite internationale des arts: Research and Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.citeinternationaledesarts.fr/appels-a-candidature/association-francoise-pour-loeuvre-contemporaine-x-cite-internationale-des-arts/
    Association Francoise pour l'oeuvre contemporaine / Cite internationale des arts · deadline Closed 16 Aug 2026 · Grant of EUR 1,000 net of tax per month, plus a furnished studio-apartment (20 to 35 sq m, combining living and working space), international return travel to Paris airports or stations, travel insurance, and capped research support against receipts. Additional fees apply for accompanying persons. No application fee.
  • Creative Residency at Bloedel Reserve: Class of 2027
    https://bloedelreserve.slideroom.com/#/login/program/88209
    Bloedel Reserve · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 22 application fee. Furnished private house on the grounds with linens, stocked kitchen, wi-fi, laundry and use of a smart car; an electric piano is available. Domestic residents receive a USD 1,000 stipend. International residents receive no stipend and may instead submit up to USD 1,000 of expenses for reimbursement. Residents pay for their own meals and their own travel to Bainbridge Island. There is no dedicated studio; residents work in the house.

    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/research-trip-to-switzerland/

Applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 1,000 per month toward childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 06 Jul 2026 (06 Jul to 12 Jul 2026).

    https://forms.gle/5btrxy7LwfY8QyFW6
    Chornobyl40 (gate22 / European Institute of Chornobyl consortium) · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · Residency is free to attend. For the 20 projects selected for production: EUR 500 grant for fully digital works or EUR 1,000 grant for installations requiring physical materials, plus inclusion in the international exhibition. Travel, accommodation, and transport are not covered. No application fee.
  • Ucross General Residency (All Disciplines): Spring 2027
    https://www.ucrossfoundation.org/residency-program.html
    Ucross Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · No charge for the residency; living accommodations, meals, and work space provided. USD 40 application fee.

    https://www.listasafn.is/en/art/news-vasulka-stofa/
    National Gallery of Iceland (Listasafn Islands), CUSP project · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · Accommodation and working space for the residency; travel and subsistence stipend; an artist fee for collaborating in the open-lab/masterclass; and, depending on the artist's request and museum means, hardware and software for the working space. No application fee.
  • EFFEA Call #5: European Festivals Fund for Emerging Artists
    https://www.effea.eu/news/item/2026/06/24/effea-call-5-get-ready

    Kaatsbaan Cultural Park · deadline Rolling / undated · Generously subsidized residency; includes hotel-style on-campus rooms, locally sourced meals, and access to studios, a 160-seat black box theater, and a 153-acre Hudson Valley campus. No artist stipend.

item.title: 7 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
7 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 01 Jun 2026 (01 Jun to 07 Jun 2026).

  • OASIS: Disappearing Landscape Residency 2026 (High Tatras, Slovakia)
    https://www.machaon.eu/en/news/disappearing-landscape-2026-open-call
    Association for Nature Conservation - Machaon International, with Kolaj 22 and Ukrainian-Slovak HUB (European OASIS project) · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · Artist fee up to EUR 1,300; travel support up to EUR 300 (for international artists); production/material support up to EUR 300; accommodation and meals; access to workspaces and partner venues; organisational support and networking; public presentation opportunities; excursions in the High Tatras region. No application fee.
  • PRAKSIS: Opening Doors Nordic/Baltic Artist Residency 2026 (Oslo)
    https://on-the-move.org/news/praksis-opening-doors-nordicbaltic-artist-residency-2026-norway
    PRAKSIS (funded by the Nordic Culture Fund; Opening Doors co-funded by the European Union via Erasmus+ Youth) · deadline Closed 17 Jun 2026 · Accommodation in Oslo; shared studio space at PRAKSIS; residency stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for three months (EUR 4,800 total); travel support of EUR 350; production/materials allowance of EUR 400. No application fee.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme Autumn 2027 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
  • Pier-2 Art Center Artist-in-Residence Programme (PAIR) 2027 (Kaohsiung, Taiwan)
    https://www.pier2air.tw/en/
    Pier-2 Art Center · deadline Closed 05 Jul 2026 · A 33 sqm studio with private bathroom plus 16.5 sqm living space; art exchange area and opportunities; one round-trip economy class flight ticket OR one round-trip reserved-seat high-speed rail ticket (depending on artist's place of residence); daily living allowance of NTD 800 per person or group; project-based material subsidy up to NTD 35,000; an assigned project manager. No application fee.
  • Faber Andorra Residency 2027
    https://faberllull.cat/en/residencia.cfm?id=45820
    Faberllull · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · EUR 60 daily meal allowance plus fully equipped apartment (free) and 30 sqm visual/performing arts workshop. Travel and medical insurance NOT covered. No application fee.
  • Grand Canyon Conservancy Residency 2027 (Artist / Astronomer / Environmental Educator)
    https://www.grandcanyon.org/experience-grand-canyon/residency-program
    Grand Canyon Conservancy (Grand Canyon National Park) · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Free on-site accommodation in the park, financial support (honorarium/stipend; amount varies by track and session - confirm on the track-specific page), plus marketing/exposure through the Conservancy and the National Park. Alumni network access. No application fee. Three tracks (Artist / Astronomer / Environmental Educator) - apply to one track per cycle.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme 2028 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
